patterns.note: The page uses a strong alternating section layout, switching between full-width dark green backgrounds with light text and light gray backgrounds with dark text to delineate content blocks.

A distinct monospaced font is consistently used for command-line instructions, code snippets, and technical labels, providing clear visual separation from the primary sans-serif headings and body text.
A high-contrast color palette of deep forest green and light off-white is used, punctuated by a vibrant, almost neon, accent green for primary calls to action and interactive elements.

A dynamic, pixelated green background animation, reminiscent of a digital glitch or data stream, is consistently used across all dark-themed sections, including the hero, pricing, and footer, providing continuous visual interest.
Feature explanations are presented as numbered steps, each accompanied by a detailed screenshot or UI mockup that visually demonstrates the step, enhancing clarity and user understanding.

technique_notes: The site uses a full-bleed, dark green background for key sections, featuring a dynamic, generative pixelated animation (likely canvas-based, as hinted by 'canvas' tech) that creates a tech-glitch or data stream effect. This animated texture provides continuous visual interest and reinforces the technical nature of the product.

Content is structured in alternating full-width sections with high contrast backgrounds (dark green with light text, light gray with dark text) to clearly delineate different topics and create visual rhythm.
Interactive elements like buttons and input fields feature subtle rounded corners and use a bright accent green for primary calls to action, providing clear visual hierarchy.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with a clear hierarchy, complemented by a smaller, distinct monospaced font for code examples.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (e.g., 4-8px) on buttons, input fields, and some card elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and within the hero, but a tighter grid for feature cards and pricing.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the animated, pixelated green background that permeates the dark sections of the site. It effectively communicates a high-tech, data-driven, and slightly 'glitchy' aesthetic, setting it apart from typical clean SaaS designs by adding a layer of dynamic visual interest without being distracting.
